title: Best AI Tools for Small Business Owners in 2026 (Under $100/mo Total)
description: The exact AI stack a 5-person small business needs to compete with enterprise: writing, marketing, customer support, ops. Under $100/mo total.
short_desc: Complete AI stack for small business. Under $100/mo.
tldr_pick: ChatGPT Team ($25/user) for general AI. Jasper ($49) for marketing copy. Canva Pro ($13) for design. Tidio ($29) for AI customer support. Total: under $120/mo for a 5-person team.
key_takeaways: You don't need 10 different AI subscriptions — 4-5 tools cover everything
ChatGPT Team ($25/user) is the best general AI for small teams
Jasper's brand voice training is worth it if you publish content daily
Tidio or Intercom Fin handle 80% of support tickets without humans

faq.q: How much should a small business spend on AI tools?
faq.a: $50-150/mo per team member is the sweet spot. Below $50/mo you're missing critical tools. Above $200/mo you're paying for features you don't use.

faq.q: Which single AI tool should I start with?
faq.a: ChatGPT Team. It's the most versatile — covers writing, analysis, code review, and customer support drafts. $25/user/month, cancel anytime.

faq.q: Do I need AI customer support?
faq.a: If you get more than 50 tickets/day, yes. Tidio or Intercom Fin handles the routine 80% automatically and saves you from hiring a support rep.

verdict_headline: Four tools, $116/mo total — complete AI stack for a 5-person team
verdict_body: Stop subscribing to every new AI tool. These four cover everything a small business actually needs.
methodology: We ran a simulated 5-person small business for 3 months using each tool category. Measured actual productivity gains (hours saved per week) vs subscription cost.
